scope: Per-item media type on album items (Decision 5 type-mixing predicate). Diff across MediaItem, MediaItemDto, StepExecutor, FunnelService + tests.

findings.finding: Exhaustive switch over BlockType maps IMAGE/VIDEO/AUDIO/FILE to Telegram element types; TEXT/ALBUM throw IllegalStateException. Unreachable at runtime because FunnelService.validateAlbum rejects those kinds on save, but the throw documents the invariant and keeps the switch exhaustive. Acceptable.

Type-mixing predicate collapses IMAGE+VIDEO to a single 'visual' bucket and counts distinct kinds among {visual, audio, file}; >1 distinct kind = invalid mix. Matches Decision 5 exactly (photo/video mix OK; audio and document each homogeneous-only). Clean and minimal.
type threaded through toMediaItems (DTO->domain) and toMediaItemDtos (domain->DTO), so save->fetch round-trips the per-item type. Mirrors the existing field-by-field mapping style.

notes: No correctness, reuse, or simplicity issues. New MediaItem shape is record MediaItem(BlockType type, String mediaUrl, String caption). No behavior change outside album handling. caption-on-first invariant unchanged.
